title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E06 — Texas Tornado
When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses find themselves trapped in the path; as they seek the best shelter they can find, they capture the moments when tornadoes destroy the very structures around them.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E13 — Three Rivers, Four Tornadoes
A lone supercell thunderstorm in March 2026 spawns unexpected late winter tornadoes in the upper Midwest, including the earliest-ever EF-3 tornado to hit Michigan.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E14 — EF-4 vs. Air Force Base
In April 2026, tornadoes rip through northern Oklahoma, forcing residents to take cover. As the outbreak reaches its peak, a massive EF-4 touches down near the town of Enid, striking Vance Air Force Base before tearing through a nearby neighborhood.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E06 — Flood of the Century
When a freak storm unleashes a tornado and a year's worth of rainfall on the city of Valencia, Spain, eyewitnesses capture catastrophic flooding in the urban center; bridges buckle, cars are swept away and residents fight for their lives.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E06 — Shaq's Super Truck
NBA star Shaquille O'Neal shows up unannounced at Apocalypse, to Jerry Jr.'s delight - he's been trying to get Shaq's attention for over a year; Joe begins work on Shaq's Juggernaut, but Jerry repeatedly interferes, forcing Ashley to step in.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E15 — A Bridge Too Far
An Arctic storm blows Sig's Northwestern off course during its opening set of the Golden King; Jake faces the loss of his longtime engineer; Monte takes the wheel of the Wizard when Keith inexplicably collapses in the wheelhouse.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E05 — Backcountry Crooks
Uncharted wilderness and untamed backcountry full of rugged terrain and wild inhabitants; police officers surviving and thriving as they take down criminals, prevent catastrophes and save lives.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E05 — Raids and Busts
Elusive criminals evade the law, but relentless specialized units track them down on the streets, in the skies and across the seas -- busting smugglers, counterfeiters and hostage takers with cameras catching every moment.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E07 — Doorbell Camera Disasters
Absurd offenses and misdeeds go down every day on every street in the USA; from porch pirates and scammers to car crashes and police takedowns, millions of doorbells and home security cameras are standing by to record the footage.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E01 — Heists
Jewel thieves use their imagination for huge scores; ATMs face brutal assaults from heavy machinery to get to the loot inside; during a daring attempt to rob an armored car, one driver becomes a hero.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E13 — Grand Theft Viral
When jewel thieves get stuck in a shop, a fleeing carjacker hides in a port-a-potty, and a criminal tries to escape in a 20-ton construction vehicle, the law fights back and puts them behind bars.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E11 — Escaping the Law
Criminals try anything to avoid capture, but specially trained police use non-lethal methods to leave bad guys tased and confused; an officer risks life and limb atop a moving vehicle, and an escaped convict puts on the charm to avoid being captured.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E07 — Crooks Gone Wild
When crooks and criminals run for freedom, the police aren't far behind; lawbreakers utilize every tool at their disposal to make their escape and officers must do the same in this dangerous battle of wits, speed and weaponry.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E02 — Driving Disasters
Roadways and waterways are full of hazards, dangers and accidents waiting to happen; traffic cams, cell phones and dash cams get it all on video when sailboats crash into piers, a woman steals a cop car, and a cow-carrying convoy spills its cargo.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E18 — Trains, Planes and Flying Fists
By land, air, rail or sea -- with so many ways to travel, one'd think it would be a breeze; but leave it to fellow travelers to bring one to one's knees, causing unexpected turmoil along the way.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E09 — Insane on a Plane
In the world of air travel, crime and misconduct are skyrocketing, causing unruly travelers to be denied boarding; protesting passengers create turbulence for everyone on board; when mechanical issues arise, the real chaos begins.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E05 — San Francisco County Jail
In a city gripped by fentanyl and rising drug arrests, San Francisco's largest jail is on the front lines of addiction; it fights to give inmates a shot at recovery, rehabilitation and a path forward.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E06 — Flagler County Jail
At Florida's Flagler County Jail, law and order Sheriff Rick Staly takes a tough approach to corrections while battling the revolving door of repeat offenders through discipline, rehabilitation, and recovery programs.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E04 — Semi-Pro
When a lone driver avoids answering officers' questions, an X-ray reveals dark shadows along her car's floorboard, a sign she could be smuggling narcotics; a semi-pro boxer is detained after being flagged for having a warrant for his arrest.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E03 — The Breeder's Cup
Officers find an 18-wheeler carrying more than a load of takeout containers; a couple raises suspicion after declaring bulldog semen, but the labeling suggests the box may actually contain stallion semen, a valuable and tightly regulated substance.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E05 — Roses in Red, Violence in Blue
A traveler is caught with blades for cockfighting, a cartel-run blood sport; every year, Mexico grows millions of dollars of flowers for the U.S., but cartels are taking advantage of the influx of shipments during major holidays.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E06 — All the Mayor's Men
Two men arrive in an SUV carrying enough suitcases for an entire family. Officers discover it's no family car -- it's a Kevlar-lined, bulletproof tank, the type that the cartels use to transport high-ranking gang members and attack law enforcement.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
No Gun Intended
Drug cartels are estimated to control up to one-third of Mexico's territory — there's an insatiable demand for guns and ammo south of the border, and a ready supply of Americans willing to smuggle them. CBP is ready to intercept.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E13 — Rogers County Jail
In one tough county in Oklahoma, an underfunded jail runs on empty as rookie officers face harsh realities on the job and the inmates search for a second chance behind bars, fighting to build a future they never thought possible.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E12 — Loudoun County Adult Detention Center
In one of America's wealthiest counties, Loudoun County Adult Detention Center serves the wealthy and the impoverished alike by running rehab programs, chasing contraband, and giving every inmate — rich or poor — a shot at a brighter future.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E04 — Wood County Jail
After nearly two decades of economic decline and a surge in methamphetamine use, Wood County, Wisconsin opens a new $93 million jail, where staff faces mounting pressure to help a community searching for a way forward.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E05 — Desert Gold Boom
Dave Turin shows viewers where and how to find Mojave gold; from traditional dry washing techniques and an ancient Spanish method using a blanket to a modern prospector using his trusty vacuum, there's big gold for the taking.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E16 — My Brother's Keeper
After Keith suffers a cardiac event at sea, Monte races to get his brother to the nearest airstrip for medevac; as the fleet prays for Keith's safety, the Wizard crew must navigate the notoriously dangerous port entry at Saint Paul.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S06 E06 — Tea Party Rebellion
Tea and liquor; two beverages Americans will fight a rebellion for; Mark, Digger, and Tim judge as three distillers compete to turn America's duo of hard-won drinks into one top-selling spirit for a chance to win the title of Master Distiller.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E16 — Stock Car Champions
The King Richard Petty and racing champions Thad Moffitt and Brendan Gaughan team up with moonshine legends Mark, Digger and Tim in a backroads reunion 90 years in the making; only one team will earn the honorary title of Master Distiller.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E17 — Race to the Finish Line
With the title on the line, Team Petty and Team Gaughan summon their bootlegging heritage to run championship liquor; as the competition heats up on the stills, Mark and Tim face off on the track, leaving one shiner crashing into the wall.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S07 E01 — Prison Shine
Tickle, Tim and Henry serve as judge and jury while two outlaws and one legal distiller take on the hard-time challenge of turning prison commissary ingredients into high-proof contraband.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S07 E02 — Chef-Distiller Showdown
Nobody knows more about flavor than professional chefs; guest judge Robert Irvine presides over a pressure cooker of competition as three experienced chefs battle to turn raw ingredients into high-proof, culinary-class spirits.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E03 — Helene's Appalachian Hellscape
Hurricane Helene barrels north into Appalachia, dumping 30 inches of rain; as hundreds of cameras capture flooding and mudslides, one woman gets swept away by the deluge, until a man attending a wedding rehearsal jumps into the water to save her.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E02 — Category 5: Fight to Survive
After hitting Category five, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E01 — Tornado Torrent 2025
In March 2025, thousands of eyewitnesses capture disaster at their doorsteps as extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 150 tornadoes across the southern states, devastating towns and homesteads in their path.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E09 — The Texas Flood
Unrelenting rainfall in central Texas turns the Fourth of July into a fight for survival.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E01 — Nightmare in May
In mid-May 2025, hundreds of eyewitnesses capture the power of severe weather as supercell thunderstorms unleash dozens of powerful tornadoes, tossing vehicles across highways and destroying neighborhoods and workplaces in eleven states.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E02 — Fab Four and a Big Score
A police officer's house in North Carolina is packed with fishing gear, rare Beatles records, guns and knives; in Tennessee, sports memorabilia has taken over a family's home; total sales top $100,000; a client is moved to give Matt a tribute.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E08 — Mega Bites for Mega Bucks
In a house packed with oddities, Matt finds megalodon teeth, tribal masks and Civil War bullets; the team struggles to make the kitchen functional again; after low-ball offers, Matt scrambles and lands his biggest payday yet.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E05 — Mummy on the Ghost Ship
When a mummy is discovered on an abandoned boat, investigators struggle to explain where it came from; Jeremy Wade reveals what happened and the strange forces to blame for this mysterious phenomenon on the high seas.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E17 — Out Cold
As Keith fights for his life at Anchorage General, Sig helps his brother Monte to get back on the crab.

title: Expedition X
description:
S05 E03 — Mexico's Haunted Cenotes
In the Yucatán, Phil and Jess investigate watery caverns believed to be portals to the Maya underworld; some say angry spirits are to blame for strange lights and bizarre animal behavior, but the sacred cenotes hide secrets darker than any legend.

title: Expedition X
description:
S05 E01 — Ring of Fire UFOs
Phil and Jess probe the science behind a strange phenomenon while investigating mysterious objects flying around Mexico's tallest active volcano.

title: Expedition X
description:
S03 E04 — Ghosts in the Canal
Josh wants to investigate ghostly sightings and terrifying sounds coming from an abandoned canal along the Potomac; Jess and Phil dive into the murky depths and search secret tunnels.

title: Expedition X
description:
S06 E06 — Hellfire Club
Phil and Jess travel to Ireland and the U.K. to investigate a centuries-old secret society whose most elite members were known to practice satanic worship and ritual sacrifice.

title: Expedition X
description:
S07 E01 — Transylvanian Terror
Phil and Jess explore the world's most haunted forest near the site of the Dracula legend and where Josh Gates had his most terrifying experience; during a night investigation, Jess finds herself being watched by someone or something sinister.

title: Expedition X
description:
S06 E05 — Ghost Town
Phil and Jess investigate an abandoned gold mining town haunted by its inhabitants from over a century ago; traveling deep inside the town's deserted mines, they uncover the town's blood-soaked secrets and a multitude of paranormal activity.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S28 E01 — Skinwalker Invasion
Zak Bagans and the crew navigate sacred ground to investigate a family's reports of skinwalker encounters in a remote Utah town; the desecration of ancient artifacts may have awoken a darkness that threatens all who dare to step onto the property.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E10 — Doll of Fire
The team helps a family that has been driven from their home by an entity; their misfortunes begin when they take in a doll from a hoarder's home; Zak fears that whatever inhabits the doll is responsible for a mysterious fire.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E02 — Possession in Pilot Rock
The crew is unexpectedly called to confront demonic forces in rural Oregon.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E01 — Buried Secrets of Hitler
With word of an urgent lead, Josh jets to Poland to join in the opening of a secret Nazi tunnel system dug into a dormant volcano; Josh helps a local team tear away a stone wall built by the Germans in the last days of World War II.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E02 — Buried Secrets of the Nazis
Josh Gates rafts into an abandoned tunnel system to chase art and treasure stolen by the Third Reich; the diary of a high-ranking SS officer leads to a search for tons of stolen gold; Josh searches for a buried Nazi Enigma machine.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E04 — Mystery of Dead Mountain
Braving sub-zero conditions in Siberia, Josh Gates investigates the Dyatlov Pass incident, during which nine hikers died under suspicious circumstances in 1959.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E05 — Siberia's Coldest Case
Josh Gates concludes his in-depth investigation of the Dyatlov Pass incident; taking on Dead Mountain's brutal conditions, Josh and two investigators retrace the last steps of the hikers; a big discovery could finally solve the mystery.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E07 — Lost Tomb of the Viking King
Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald Bluetooth Gormsson; the discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: The Real Goonies Treasure
For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E03 — Mansion of Unholiness
Zak and the crew gain access to a palatial California estate where spectral nuns roam its halls and a dark, oppressive energy terrorizes the staff; the team quickly discovers this is a haunting unlike any other they've encountered.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S29 E04 — Abandoned at Whiskey Pete's
Zak and the crew find themselves in an eerie desert town to investigate a casino haunted by the spirit of a notorious bootlegger; the team and comedian Matt Rife confront the dark energy that lurks around every corner.

title: Harpoon Hunters
description:
S01 E08 — Fog of War
With less than a quarter of the bluefin quota still available to catch, a change in weather forces captains to shift their strategy; Tyler quickly scores three big fish; Joe takes to the air, he spots a lone tuna, then races to find it at sea.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E18 — Graveyard for the Lost
John risks capsizing while fishing with a slack tank; Jake hauls in a large sea; under pressure to get home for the arrival of Mandy's second child, Sig and Clark fish deeper than ever before as mechanical problems mount.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E08 — High-Rise Hotel Battlefield
A slice of the Miami suburbs stands out for its style and history; a hotel in Lebanon carries the scars of a civil war; a pirate radio station gets a mixed reception.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E01 — Hunt for the Nazi Gold Train
A Polish castle becomes entwined in the hunt for lost Nazi treasure, the heir of an American business tycoon gets caught in a web of controversy, and an Irish estate is embroiled in a fight for freedom.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E02 — Schindler's Deception
A place of hope in the Czech Republic quietly perseveres in the age of Nazi tyranny; a Moroccan politician sides with the French; an eco-friendly paradise in the Amazon proves to be unsustainable.
